verdict.rationale: Rippling IT is an identity and access management product, so passwordless sign-in is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents passkeys, authenticator-based passwordless login, or platform biometrics. The federated identity protocol support (LDAP, AD, OIDC, RADIUS, SAML) and the API bearer and OAuth tokens are adjacent features, not passwordless employee sign-in.

support.subject: As an employee, I can sign in without a password — passwordless flows via passkeys, authenticator, or platform biometrics documented and supported
